evals.prompt: How do I make my invoicing app go viral?
evals.expected_output: Should check the spread mechanism first. An invoicing app sends invoices to clients, which IS a communication loop similar to Calendly, so the recipient surface is the loop. Should identify that if the invoice is unbranded there is no loop at all. Should warn that K greater than 1 sustained is rare and set expectations at 0.3-0.7. Should emphasize cycle time as often easier to move than K.
assertions: Identifies the spread mechanism before recommending tactics
Finds the existing recipient surface as the loop
Gives the K = i x c formula
States that sustained K greater than 1 is rare
Notes cycle time matters as much as K

evals.prompt: Design a share feature for our habit tracker.
evals.expected_output: Should use Wordle as the reference implementation and extract the principles: encode the result without spoiling, no account required, plain text that travels anywhere, socially safe to post. Should warn against the common failure of a share button that broadcasts an ad. Should design for what makes the sharer look good. May raise nomination (ALS Ice Bucket) as stronger than sharing.
assertions: Cites Wordle's emoji grid as the reference
Names socially-safe sharing as the design constraint
Warns against share buttons that broadcast an ad
Designs for the sharer's benefit not the company's
Specifies a format that travels outside the app
